incidents.name: Uranium Finance v2 pair k-check miscalculation
incidents.notes: The v2 UraniumPair.swap() scaled its balance adjustment by 10000 for the new fee but kept Uniswap's 1000**2 factor on the reserve side of the constant-product require, making the post-swap invariant check 100x too weak and letting the attacker take ~99% of each pair's reserves for a token dust input.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is the v2 WBNB/BUSD pair 0x9b9bad4c returned by UraniumFactory 0xa943ea143cd7e79806d670f4a7cf08f8922a454f at the attack block, created 2021-04-16 by 0x659aab4b03053fe60002778efe104562a3909762 (the v2 migration), not by attack sender 0xc47bdd0a; the single tx drained several sibling pairs sharing the same pair code
